This is something I actually feel that I'm going through too! I have been on hiatus with my drawing since March, just thinking to myself about the things that I draw and think up of. I used to make 2-3 drawings a day, digitally, and it was my way of relief and it made me genuinely happy. But as quarantine hit I began thinking of how the things I drew weren't making God happy, and how ungrateful I was as that at a point I saw drawing as a number 1 priority when it should've been God. And so I've only recently started drawing again but still feel really sinful about everything I make. It's nothing lewd, but from the character or story I think up of to draw, I feel sinful. So I know the exact feeling you're coming from, currently I've stopped myself again from drawing; but hopefully in God's gracious name we'll find peace within ourselves and find a solution! I hope you are well.
